title: Chapter 256: Clearing The Underground Bunker
content:
Chapter 256: Clearing The Underground Bunker

If the Zerg host can see it, it is equivalent to the Zerg destroyer seeing it. After the unified coordination and command of the Queen, the attack of the high-star Zerg destroyers is like having a perspective eye, focusing on the location where a large number of defenders gathered in the 66th city.

However, with the protection of various solid bunkers, the casualties of the alien defenders who entered the bunkers in the city were much less.

Faced with this situation, Wu Qing was not in a hurry. He asked the Zerg host to find those bunkers with weaker defense capabilities and more hidden personnel, and use high-star Zerg destroyers to concentrate fire on them.

The powerful firepower of the high-star Zerg destroyers first blew up the bunker buildings on the ground, and then blew up the personnel in them, so that a large nest could be blown up!

It took a lot of time for the Zerg destroyers to break through all the simple bunkers and eliminate the enemies gathered inside.

The strength of the alien defenders was reduced again.

The remaining bunkers in the city were all underground and very solid, which made the attacks of the Zerg destroyers below five-star strength basically ineffective.

Wu Qing simply let all the Zerg destroyers rest and recover. The Zerg destroyers were the first to be upgraded to two stars or above. They have always been the main force of the Zerg army's firepower output. They were not upgraded this time, so their condition was not very good.

The siege launched by the Zerg army stopped suddenly at this point.

The alien city defense troops in the 66th city all hid in the solid underground bunkers. The ground defense in the city had to be abandoned under the fierce attack of the Zerg destroyers.

This is the first time that Wu Qing and the Zerg have encountered such a normal city defense army. As soon as they saw that they would suffer a loss in the fight, they hid immediately.

There are still a lot of troops in the city defense troops. If the Zerg sends the ground troops with long-range combat advantages to the city to fight the underground clearing war, there will be too many variables and it is easy to cause a lot of losses.

Wu Qing first asked the five-star Zerg hosts to approach for reconnaissance. Through their powerful perception and anti-stealth capabilities, they collected information about the underground bunkers in the city and provided it to Wu Qing and the Queen for decision-making.

After fighting for so long, it was already late at night, especially the Zerg destroyers attacking the alien human defenders in the bunkers, which took a lot of time.

Since the attack had stopped, Wu Qing asked the entire Zerg army to maintain its formation and enter a rest state, and not fight for the time being.

Such a rest without camping would definitely not be effective for the armies of other races, but for the Zerg army, it would not affect their rest and recovery at all.

With the Zerg hosts monitoring the surroundings, any slight movement could not escape their surveillance, and the Zerg army did not need to allocate troops to be responsible for vigilance.

Wu Qing's consciousness also returned to the main body and entered a rest state.

He already had some ideas. After dawn, he would decide how to implement them according to the situation of the alien human defenders in the 66th city.

Others, seeing that the Zerg army had stopped fighting and rested directly, also entered a rest state.

…

The sky was bright, and after a full rest and recovery, all the Zerg troops were back to their best condition.

Even those parasitic light griffin knights who were still wounded yesterday, with the powerful assistance of the silkworm, have also recovered their condition and combat power.

More than 900 five-star parasitic light griffin knights, some of whom are powerful, have the assistance of the unrestricted silkworm, plus the magical ability of the silkworm nine changes, their strength is infinitely close to six stars.

Their combat power level is not inferior to those weaker six-star troops.

Those ordinary parasitic knights have also been improved, and their combat power has reached the peak of five stars.

These parasitic light griffin knights are all aliens. Wu Qing looked at their faces and found that they were actually some humans with western appearance features, which were no different from the humans in Wu Qing's cognition.

The human race in the local camp is an oriental race that looks very similar to Wu Qing.

The human race has balanced capabilities in all aspects. The combat power of these parasitic knights is very strong. These nearly 1,000 top-level five-star soldiers are a force that cannot be ignored.

The various arms of the Zerg army are somewhat biased. Those five-star strength arms are not suitable for leading the team into the underground bunker of the 66th city to fight.

Wu Qing is ready to use these parasitic light griffon knights.

The alien human defenders in the 66th city knew that the Zerg army was waiting for them outside, so they stayed in the underground bunker and did not move.

In response to this situation, Wu Qing asked 100,000 two-star Zerg puppies and 10,000 two-star Zerg stealth spiders to drill out of the ground, and used the resources harvested during the siege yesterday to upgrade their strength to three stars.

The Zerg army has carried out another pre-war upgrade on demand.

100,000 three-star Zerg puppies and 10,000 three-star Zerg stealth spiders, this is the Zerg army lineup that Wu Qing is going to send out to clear out the defenders hiding in the underground bunkers in the city.

As for the strong ones, Wu Qing was going to send out more than 900 parasitic light griffon knights with strength close to six stars.

These parasitic light knights replaced their severely damaged weapons and equipment, bound them with Zerg biological colonization suits, and transformed the biological colonization suits into the appearance of their original equipment.

According to the intelligence collected by the five-star Zerg host, the underground bunkers of the 66th city should have been recently excavated by the goblins, and no effective underground defense system has been formed.

This time, the defenders in the city retreated to the underground bunkers. It was a temporary decision. So many troops entered the underground and could not be deployed.

Wu Qing sent a targeted lineup of more than 100,000, which was enough.

The Zerg army took action again, and the entire army advanced towards the 66th city, which was under close surveillance by the Zerg host.

"Are we going directly into the city?"

"It seems that there are still a large number of defenders from the evil god camp in the city who have entered the underground!"

"With the strength of the Zerg army, there will be no problem in eliminating those defenders who have entered the underground!"

"The Zerg army seems to be mostly long-range troops. In the complex underground environment, they may suffer in close combat!"

"As long as the strength is sufficient, it is only a matter of time to win this battle. The difficulty is to minimize casualties!"

"..."

Observers from various forces continued to follow up and observe the actions of the Zerg army.

These observers did not deliberately hide their whereabouts. They were observing openly, especially the observers from various tribes, who could be regarded as official observers on this public battlefield.

The performance of the armies of various tribes on the public battlefield required the evaluation and reporting of these official observers.

Through the Zerg host, Wu Qing knew the situation of each observer very well. It felt bad to be monitored by so many people all the time, but the performance of the Zerg was to be seen by these people, so he could only pretend that these observers did not exist.

The Zerg army entered the city of the 66th city, and the Zerg destroyers built a super-long-range attack position that could cover the entire city.

The Zerg Hydralisk and Zerg Cockroach, except for some troops guarding the Zerg destroyers, all other troops entered the city and occupied the advantageous terrain on the high ground according to the intelligence of the Zerg host.

The Zerg flying dragon group flew and circled over the city, with the Zerg Queen and Zerg Exploding Swarm hiding among them.

The Zerg Puppy and Zerg Stealth Spider took action with the Parasitic Light Griffin Knight.

"Look! Those captured Light Griffin Knights seem to have been brought into the city!"

"Are they going to use the Light Griffin Knights to threaten these subordinate races of the Alien Race?!"

"Will this work?"

"Or are they used as pioneers to explore the way?"

"..."

Everyone was also full of curiosity about the Zerg Army's move to bring the Parasitic Light Knights into the city, and they didn't know what tricks the Zerg Army was playing.

When the Zerg Puppies and Zerg Stealth Spiders entered the city, some of them began to drill underground and sneaked to the nearest underground bunker.

The Parasitic Light Griffin Knights went directly to the entrance and exit of the underground bunker.

The Alien Race defenders hiding in the small underground space, those goblins who were used to living underground were fine, but most of the other races' city guards were not used to living in the underground space.

Suddenly, countless terrible armor-piercing spikes emerged from the small underground space, piercing the crowded Alien Race defenders who had nowhere to escape one by one!

Those goblins who were not star soldiers were instantly cleared out and turned into light and disappeared, making the entire underground space spacious all of a sudden.

Those star soldiers of the alien race's affiliated races were suddenly attacked by this powerful ground spike and were also severely damaged. A large number of soldiers who were injured in vital parts, like the goblins, turned into light and disappeared.

This was an attack launched by the Zerg stealth spiders lurking underground. There were 10,000 Zerg stealth spiders, and the weakest ones were all three-star. This was a powerful underground attack force.

Zerg stealth spiders are experts in underground activities. Their attacks on limited underground spaces are very terrifying. The most terrifying thing is that because of their special attack methods, only they can attack the enemy, but the enemy cannot attack them.

An underground bunker that accommodated tens of thousands of alien defenders was cleaned up by Zerg stealth spiders in a very short time.

A few of the strong ones dodged the attack of the ground spikes and rushed to the entrance and exit of the underground bunker. They had long been out of sight of the outside world. The parasitic light griffin knights guarding the entrance and exit killed them with one sword!

This made the strong men of the alien human race never understand until their death why the light griffin knights appeared here and attacked them.

The attack effect of the Zerg stealth spider was surprisingly good, which made the Zerg puppy unable to play a role.

The Zerg army found a way to attack the enemies in the underground bunker. Ten thousand Zerg stealth spiders were divided into several teams. With the assistance of Zerg puppies and parasitic light griffin knights, they cleared the underground bunkers in the city one by one.
